name: Nephronophthisis

criteria.description: Evidence of chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis on renal biopsy or clinical findings
Presence of corticomedullary cysts on renal ultrasound or MRI
Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance
Identification of pathogenic mutations in NPHP genes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis and medullary cysts with or without genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to confirm diagnosis and subtype.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Polyuria and polydipsia due to impaired urinary concentrating ability
Progressive chronic kidney disease leading to end-stage renal failure
Medullary corticomedullary cysts detected on imaging

common.symptomName: Anemia secondary to chronic kidney disease
Growth retardation or failure to thrive

occasional.symptomName: Retinitis pigmentosa or other retinal dystrophies (in syndromic forms)

occasional.notes: In syndromic forms like Joubert syndrome

rare.notes: In syndromic variants such as Joubert syndrome

laboratory: Elevated serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen indicating renal failure
Urinalysis showing isosthenuria and mild proteinuria
imaging: Ultrasound showing corticomedullary cysts and increased echogenicity
MRI may reveal cystic changes and associated brain abnormalities in syndromic forms
genetic: Mutations in NPHP1, NPHP2 (INVS), NPHP3, and other NPHP genes
other: Renal biopsy showing tubulointerstitial fibrosis and tubular basement membrane disruption

distinguishingFeatures: More prominent cystic changes in medulla
Multiple large cysts throughout kidney cortex and medulla
Dominant or recessive inheritance depending on type

redFlags: Rapid progression to end-stage renal disease in childhood
Family history of early-onset renal failure
Presence of extrarenal manifestations such as retinal dystrophy or liver fibrosis
references: Hildebrandt F, et al. Nephronophthisis: disease mechanisms of a ciliopathy. J Am Soc Nephrol. 2009;20(1):23-35.
Wolf MT, Hildebrandt F. Nephronophthisis. Pediatr Nephrol. 2011;26(2):181-94.
